stories.title: Iran presents a roadmap for reopening the Strait of Hormuz in three-hour UN talks with Witkoff and Kushner
stories.reason: Foreign Minister Araghchi's delegation, joined for most of the session by Qatar's prime minister, laid out conditions including lifting the naval blockade, unfreezing Iranian assets and ending the war on all fronts, with Trump calling it 'very productive' and both sides planning another meeting soon.

stories.title: In defiant UN speech, Pezeshkian says Iran will fight 'until our last breath' and calls out Trump by name
stories.reason: A day after Trump said he might 'annihilate' Iran, Pezeshkian told the General Assembly 'we are not terrorists' and held up photos of Iran's supreme leader and children killed in the war, a rare wartime address by a leader whose country remains at war with the host nation.

stories.title: Zelensky proposes an 'energy ceasefire' with Russia and calls for a trilateral summit with Putin and Trump
stories.reason: Speaking at the UN a day after meeting Trump, Zelensky said Ukraine's long-range strikes aim to cut off Russia's war-funding oil revenue rather than fuel supplies, and pressed India and other buyers to stop financing Moscow's war machine through energy trade.

stories.title: OpenAI slashes prices with GPT-6 Sol and Luna as an AI-model price war erupts among OpenAI, xAI and Anthropic
stories.reason: Sol and Luna cut API costs up to 50% versus the prior GPT-5.6 tier, arriving just a day after xAI's Grok 4.7 undercut frontier pricing by 80% and hours after Anthropic's Opus 5.5 response, signaling an intensifying price war across the top AI labs.

stories.title: Alibaba unveils its most powerful AI chip yet and commits over $53 billion to AI infrastructure
stories.reason: The Zhenwu V900 chip triples the performance of its predecessor and can link clusters of up to 500,000 accelerators, part of a push toward 20 gigawatts of global data-center capacity by 2032 that sent Alibaba's Hong Kong shares up 3% as it challenges Nvidia directly.

stories.title: Meta quietly used human contractors to handle calls for its Muse AI assistant, rolling the feature back after a racist remark surfaced
stories.reason: Meta tested the 'human concierge' fallback after businesses kept hanging up on AI callers, but employees flagged privacy risks and a contractor was found to have made a racist comment on one call, prompting a Superintelligence Labs executive to call the undisclosed rollout 'a miss.'

stories.title: Countries remain far behind on UN's 30x30 biodiversity target with 2030 deadline approaching
stories.reason: Only 20% of land and 10% of oceans are protected against the goal of 30%, with researchers finding an annual funding shortfall of $75-150 billion and just 3.5% of nominally protected ocean area considered effectively managed.

stories.title: Nasdaq notches a second straight record close as the five-year Treasury yield hits 5% for the first time since 2007
stories.reason: AI stocks kept powering gains even as rising yields and hawkish Fed commentary pressured banks and small caps, with the Russell 2000 sinking as bond markets priced in a longer stretch of elevated interest rates.
